name: Dhamma Medini
tradition: Vipassana as taught by S.N. Goenka (U Ba Khin lineage, Theravada-derived)
technique: Anapana breath focus, then body-scanning Vipassana; Noble Silence
teacherAccess: Recorded evening discourses from Goenka; live Assistant Teacher gives technique-only guidance and brief interviews, no personal counseling
retreatOptions: 3-day (old students), standard 10-day, Satipatthana Sutta course, 20-day for qualified old students, plus children's/teen courses
about: New Zealand's only permanent Goenka Vipassana center, operating on rural land in the Makarau Valley since the mid-1990s. Runs the standard worldwide Goenka course structure with separate men's and women's housing and dining, strict Noble Silence, and no ritual or devotional content. Popular with both first-time sitters and long-term old students pursuing longer courses.
schedule: Frequent courses year-round per published calendar
cost: Dana/donation-only; no fee charged, voluntary donation after course completion
workNotes: New students do not work; volunteer 'servers' handle logistics separately.
